text: TEN Ltd is Tsakos Energy Navigation Limited, a Bermuda company quoted on the New York Stock Exchange. Its 2026 proxy statement lists, as of 30 March 2026, the holders it knows to own 5% or more of its common shares: Tsakos Holdings Foundation (3,223,003 shares, 10.7%), a Liechtenstein foundation that is the sole owner of First Tsakos Investments (2,485,002 shares, 8.2%) and Redmont Trading (738,001 shares, 2.4%), and four companies controlled by chief executive Nikolas Tsakos, alone or with his father Panayotis Tsakos: Sea Consolidation (5.1%), Methoni Shipping (4.8%), Tsakos Energy Management (3.6%) and Intermed Champion (3.0%). It says Nikolas Tsakos beneficially owns 5,023,802 shares and Panayotis Tsakos 2,317,202.
short: TEN Ltd is NYSE-listed Tsakos Energy Navigation; its proxy statement lists the Tsakos Holdings Foundation and companies of the Tsakos family as its holders of 5% or more.
